args.title: Juniper Labware newsletter summary — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest newsletter highlights "Freight pricing this quarter," linking to a blog article and noting a subscriber-only companion piece.
- Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/freight): Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/freight/companion, subscriber access): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
